properties.description: Warped columnar basalt forms the cliffs of the Snake River - meaning the cliffs and ground is all inhuman looking Hexagons. There's trails along the base of the cliff and you can boat up and down the river.

properties.name: Silverwood Theme Park
properties.description: The best amusement park in the Pacific Northwest is in Idaho. Featuring rollercoaster that dive underground and twist through the sky, and cowboys that will rob you on the train.

properties.name: Land of the Yankee Fork State Park
properties.description: That's right it's three gold mining ghost towns in the beautiful valleys of Idaho. Including Bayhorse, Bonanza, and Custer. There's also an abandoned gold dredge, and hot springs. Most of what you want to see will be found along Bayhorse Creek Road, Yankee Fork Road, and Hot Springs Road.

properties.name: Bruneau Sand Dunes State Park
properties.street: Bruneau Sand Dunes Visitors Center, Bruneau, ID 83604
properties.description: This out of place sand dune is the remains from the ancient Bonneville Flood. It's also the site of the largest single structure sand dune in the USA at 470ft high. There's also a pleasant lake to fish at, sandboard rentals, and an observatory to stare at the stars.

properties.name: Experimental Breeder Reactor I
properties.description: Tour an experimental 1950s nuclear power plant. EBR-1 was the first nuclear power plant to produce electricity instead of fuel for nuclear bombs. It was the world's first breeder reactor, and is now available for tour during the summer at Idaho National Labs.

properties.name: Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve
properties.description: The black lava fields, cinder cones, and lava tubes create an exotic landscape like the craters of the moon. Hike up a dead volcano, explore caves where lava once flowed, and camp under the stars of the remote Idaho wilderness.

properties.name: Shoshone Ice Caves
properties.description: These lava tubes are so cold that there's ice in them year round. There are guided tours over rickety walkways. Make sure to check out the volcanic rocks of nearby Black Magic Canyon of Big Wood River if you are already out this way.

properties.name: Minidoka National Historic Site
properties.description: During WWII the United States built concentration camps and put every American of Japanese descent into them. 13,000 Americans were imprisoned at Minidoka, and the remains of the camp are still preserved.

properties.name: Museum of Clean
properties.description: See the history of the development of cleaning chemicals and machinery. See cleaning equipment you never imagined existed, as well as folk art made of cleaning equipment. Featuring the world's first vacuum cleaner from 1860, the trash compactor from the space shuttle, and the world's largest janitor statue. The gift shop is full of cleaning supplies.

properties.name: City of Rocks National Reserve
properties.street: 3035 S Highway 77 Spur, E City of Rocks Loop Rd, Almo, ID 83312
properties.description: The rocks here jut out of the flat landscapes into steeples and spires. You can hike up and through many of the rocks here. There's also rock climbing if you have a permit.

properties.name: Castle Rocks State Park
properties.street: 748 E Castle Rock Rd, Almo, ID 83312
properties.description: The scenic granite rocks here have nearly no roads to see them - but there are plenty of hiking trails and rock climbing opportunities. This is the companion park to the nearby City of Rocks National Monument and Preserve.

properties.name: Shoshone Falls Park
properties.street: 4155 Shoshone Falls Grade Rd, Twin Falls, ID 83301
properties.description: Shoshone Falls is 212ft tall and 900ft wide - taller than Niagara Falls. This waterfall is notably set in the 500ft deep Snake River Canyon. However, this waterfall is best seen in the spring, as the rest of the year the river is diverted for irrigation.

properties.name: Twin Falls Visitor Center
properties.street: 2015 Neilsen Point Pl, Twin Falls, ID 83301
properties.description: The Twin Falls Visitor Center overlooks Snake River Canyon and the massive arch bridge that spans it. It also provides access to the canyon rim trail which contains even more overlooks into the stunning canyon.

properties.name: Centennial Waterfront Park
properties.street: Centennial Waterfront Park, Canyon Springs Rd, Twin Falls, ID 83301
properties.description: See Snake River Canyon and the Perrine Memorial Bridge from the bottom of the Snake River. You can rent kayaks and canoes here as well, and there's even more hiking to do.

properties.name: Auger Falls Heritage Park
properties.street: 1535 Cyn Spgs Rd, Twin Falls, ID 83301
properties.description: Waterfalls pour off the tops of the cliffs of Snake River canyon into the green wildlife below. You can hike up to the base of some of the waterfalls including Auger falls.

properties.name: Thousand Springs State Park
properties.description: Spring fed waterfalls pour into the Snake River in Idaho's equivalent of the Grand Canyon. Thousand Springs State Park spans the Snake River canyon, covering the numerous waterfall springs that pour as waterfalls down the sides of the cliff. These include Niagara Springs, Box Canyon Springs, Ritter Island, and Malad Gorge. The units of the park are around 20 minutes apart each, but you can easily reach all of them.

properties.name: Pictograph Cave State Park
properties.description: Hike up to to an alcove in scenic sandstone cliffs to see ancient caves full of 2,000 year old Native American pictographs.

properties.name: Lewis and Clark Caverns State Park
properties.street: 25 Lewis & Clark Caverns Road, Whitehall, MT 59759
properties.description: Tour one of the largest caves in the Northwest. There's also some scenic hiking trails surrounding the cave itself since it is set in the mountains.

properties.name: World Museum of Mining
properties.description: This is THE mining museum. Featuring a replica 1890s mine town with 50 buildings, the actual Orphan Girl Mine Yard, and a tour of the silver mines below the surface.

properties.name: Sluice Boxes State Park
properties.description: Hike along the rim and canyon and see the alcove shaved 'sluice box' caves. This park features roaring rapids, abandoned mining houses, and trails through all the levels of the canyon - you'll never have a bad view.

properties.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
properties.description: This former cannery is now home to a world class aquarium with unique tanks, including: an actual kelp forest, the sardine roundabout, hammerhead sharks and sunfish, and a rare deep sea exhibit with creatures only found at extreme depths - including a touch pool for GIANT DEEP SEA ISOPODS.

properties.name: L Anse aux Meadows
properties.street: 436 L'Anse aux Meadows Road, Newfoundland and Labrador A0K 2X0, Canada
properties.description: The Norse crossed the Atlantic and arrived in America in ~1000AD - 500 years before Columbus. L'Anse Meadows is the site of where they built a settlement - which has been partially reconstructed.

properties.name: Norstead (Newfoundland)
properties.street: 263 L'Anse Meadows, Saint Lunaire-Griquet, NL A0K 2X0, Canada
properties.description: Were the historians boring you at L'Anse aux Meadows? Let the actors at the Norstead living history village entertain you instead - they have an actual full-scale Viking ship replica. You are already at the tip of Newfoundland, it's not like you can go anywhere else.

properties.name: Gros Morne National Park
properties.street: 1 Eastlink Road, Rocky Harbour, NL A8A 3L2, Canada
properties.description: The Fjords and mountains of Gros Morne tower over the landscape of Newfoundland. Despite being on the edge of the world, there's still dedicated hiking trails so you can enjoy all the mountains, waterfalls, and lakes. This isn't the United States - you cannot see everything by driving - you will have to hike. Fun fact: this is technically part of the Appalachian mountains.

properties.name: Terra Nova National Park
properties.street: Terra Nova National Park, Trans - Canada Hwy, Glovertown, NL A0C 1H0, Canada
properties.description: The rocky coastline of Terra Nova National Park is covered in mountains with soaring views of lakes and ocean from the top. There's lots of hiking to do - it's pretty much the Newfoundland equivalent of Acadia National Park in the United States.

properties.name: Diefenbunker
properties.street: 3929 Carp Rd, Ottawa, ON K0A 1L0, Canada
properties.description: The Diefenbunker is a 1961 continuity of government nuclear fallout shelter intended for the Canadian government.  This bunker is 75ft underground and is designed to withstand a direct hit from a nuke. This is one of the few continuity of government bunkers available for tour anywhere in the world - I mean what kind of person would want to declare war on Canada?

properties.name: Canada Aviation and Space Museum
properties.street: 11 Aviation Pkwy, Ottawa, ON K1K 2X5, Canada
properties.description: Canadian aerospace has followed its own unique course with its own aircraft manufacturers such as Avro Canada, Canadair, and de Havilland Canada, . The museum features a replica of Canada's first powered aircraft - the Silver Dart, the Avro Arrow (well, the front of it), Avro Canuck, Canadair Dynavert,Northop Delta,  Fulton Airphibian flying car, and various war prizes and fighting aircraft from WW1 and WW2.

properties.name: Canada Science and Technology Museum
properties.street: 1867 St. Laurent Blvd, Ottawa, ON K1G 5A3, Canada
properties.description: Canada has maintained a technological edge in some fields and shows it off at this museum, including: hydrofoils, hydropower, nuclear reactors, building snow resistant railway trains (including a rare streamlined steam locomotive), snowmobiles, sleds, snowshoes, and sleighs. If you are wondering what Ingenium is, it's the Crown Corporation equivalent of the Smithsonian.

properties.name: Canadian War Museum
properties.street: 1 Vimy Pl, Ottawa, ON K1A 0M8, Canada
properties.description: War forged the Canadian identity from colony into country - notably defending the country against invasion in the War of 1812 and fighting as a unified Confederation during WW1. This museum follows Canadian warfare, from the First Nations to Afghanistan. The museum includes life sized trench dioramas, a re-creation of the Homefront during the world wars, and various tanks and artillery used by Canada as well as by Canada's allies and enemies. This means an eclectic mix British, German, American, and Soviet vehicles from WW1 to the end of the Cold War.

properties.name: Chaudière Falls
properties.street: Chaudiere Falls Viewing Area Ottawa, ON K1R 6K8, Canada
properties.description: There's a 50ft waterfall encapsulated by a hydroelectric dam in the middle of downtown Ottawa. The only viewing area is accessible from walkways near the Canadian War Museum.

properties.name: Canadas Wonderland
properties.description: Canada's wonderland is the most visited seasonal amusement park in North America -it's busy because it's the best amusement park in the country. The 18 rollercoasters at this park surround a massive artificial mountain with a waterfall.

properties.name: Royal Ontario Museum
properties.street: 100 Queens Park, Toronto, ON M5S 2C6, Canada
properties.description: This is the Canadian equivalent of the Smithsonian - but somehow better. Dinosaurs, overseas definitely not stolen artifacts, and a reconstruction of a building from the Beijing Imperial Palace.

properties.name: Little Canada (Attraction)
properties.street: 10 Dundas St E, Toronto, ON M5B 2G9, Canada
properties.description: Canada is the second largest country on Earth by area, what if it was much much smaller? Little Canada is Canada but represented in scale model format, including: Toronto, Ottawa, Niagara, Quebec,  the west coast (Vancouver), the east coast, and the North,

properties.name: Canadian Tank Museum
properties.street: 1000 Stevenson Rd N, Oshawa, ON L1J 5P5, Canada
properties.description: This is THE Canadian tank museum - it's 140 Canadian military vehicles from WW2 to the modern era - and they drive them to show them off.

properties.name: Queen Victoria Park
properties.street: 6345 Niagara River Pkwy, Niagara Falls, ON L2E 6X8, Canada
properties.description: Queen Victoria Park contains a trail along Niagara Gorge that gives the best views of Niagara Falls - the biggest waterfall by flowrate in North America. The entirety of the Great Lakes empties through the massive 164ft drop at 168,000 cubic meters per minute into the gorge below. Queen Victoria Park offers better views, but Niagara Falls State Park lets you get closer to the waterfalls and rapids.

properties.name: HMCS Ojibwa
properties.street: 3 Pitt St, Port Burwell, ON N0J 1T0, Canada
properties.description: Tour a British submarine nowhere near the ocean, Britain, or any major city! The Cold War era Oberon-class submarine HMCS Ojibwa was built in the United Kingdom then transferred to Canadian service - and now you can tour it.

properties.name: HMCS Haida
properties.street: 658 Catharine St N Pier 9, Hamilton, ON L8L 4V7, Canada
properties.description: The WW2 era Tribal-class destroyer HMCS Haida was built in Britain for the Canadian navy and saw service in WW2 and the Korean War. Now it sits on the edge of a massive steel refinery available for tour.

properties.name: Bruce Peninsula National Park
properties.street: 120 Chi sin tib dek Rd, Tobermory, ON N0H 2R0, Canada
properties.description: The cliffs of the Niagara Escarpment meet the impossibly clear blue waters of Lake Huron - one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world - at Bruce Peninsula National Park. There's hiking and shipwrecks. You cannot see most of this park from your car - you will need to get out and hike in order to see the coastline.

properties.name: Agawa Canyon Tour Train
properties.street: 87 Huron St, Sault Ste. Marie, ON P6A 6W4, Canada
properties.description: Agawa Canyon is a stunning waterfall filled canyon in remote Northern Ontario - only accessible by a 10 hour tour train. The tallest of the 4 major waterfalls in the canyon is 225ft tall.

properties.name: Canadian Bushplane Heritage Centre
properties.street: 50 Pim St, Sault Ste. Marie, ON P6A 3G4, Canada
properties.description: Most pilots fly sophisticated aircraft between well-paved airfields, Bush Pilots fly the equivalent of beat up used cars held together by duct tape and land them on patches of dirt. See the fastest way to get around in the Great North at the Canadian Bushplane Heritage Center.

properties.name: Lake Superior Provincial Park
properties.street: Lake Superior Provincial Park Visitors Centre, Trans-Canada Hwy, Agawa Bay, ON, Canada
properties.description: There's pictographs and dramatic cliffs on the cold granite shoreline of the largest freshwater lake in the world. There's waterfalls, river valleys, cliffs, beaches, and hiking trails to see it all.

properties.name: Sable Island National Park Reserve
properties.street: Sable Island, Halifax, NS B0J 1M0, Canada
properties.description: You know the stories about being shipwrecked on a desert island? This is that island. Sable Island is 20 miles long of nothing but sand dunes where feral horses roam in the cold emptiness of the North Atlantic. 350+ ships have wrecked on its shores. The only way in is by air.

properties.name: Yukon Transportation Museum
properties.street: 30 Electra Cres, Whitehorse, YT Y1A 0M7, Canada
properties.description: How the heck do you transport anything when there are no roads? The answers are: The Letorouneau Sno-Train - a massive tired land train with 10ft tall wheels; bush planes that can land on water, ice, and snow; and snowmobiles.

properties.name: SS Klondike
properties.street: 10 Robert Service Way, Whitehorse, YT Y1A 1V8, Canada
properties.description: Unlike the paddle steamers on the peaceful and populated Mississippi, steamers like the SS Klondike were the only supply line in the cold emptiness of the frontier and ran cargo along the Yukon River until the construction of highways in the 1950s.

properties.name: Frank Slide Interpretive Center
properties.description: Coal mining destabilized Turtle Mountain leading to the 1903 landslide which crushed the town of Frank and killed 90+ people. The mountain still looks shattered, the town is still buried, and you can walk amongst the vast field of rocks from the landslide still fills the valley.

properties.name: Royal Tyrrell Museum of Palaeontology
properties.street: 1500 N Dinosaur Trail, Drumheller, AB T0J 0Y0, Canada
properties.description: This is THE Canadian dinosaur museum. This fossil museum is set in the middle of the badlands in which the fossils were found.

properties.name: Dinosaur Provincial Park
properties.street: Dinosaur Provincial Park Visitor Centre, Iddesleigh, AB T0J 2K0, Canada
properties.description: The Red Deer valley is full of scenic badlands full of fossils of dinosaurs. Dinosaur Provincial park is 62sqkm of hikeable badlands - it's basically the equivalent of Badlands National Park in the United States.

properties.name: Oil Sands Discovery Centre
properties.street: 515 MacKenzie Blvd, Fort McMurray, AB T9H 4X3, Canada
properties.description: Imagine if oil was a rock - that's the Athabasca Oil Sands and the center of the Albertan Petroleum Industry. At the Oil Sands Discovery Centre you can learn why oil is really the greatest thing ever, and see the excavation devices that turn oily rock into oil. The star is the Big Bucketwheel, which looks like an office building sized giant robot arm with a spinning blade at the end.

properties.name: Pukaskwa National Park
properties.street: Hattie Cover Visitor Centre, Thunder Bay, Unorganized, ON P0T 1R0, Canada
properties.description: In the heart of Canada's boreal forests lay rocky waterfalls and rapids spilling towards the granite shores of Lake Superior. The White River Suspension Bridge Trail will take you right over the gorge where Chigamiwinigum Falls are - but it's an all day 18km hike. This is not a 'drive through' type National Park, you need to hike - does this seem like the part of the world that has roads?

properties.name: Great Lakes Museum
properties.street: 55 Ontario St, Kingston, ON K7L 2L1, Canada
properties.description: The 1907 Great Lakes Passenger Liner SS Keewatin is the centerpiece of this museum on Canadian Great Lakes history - and is the largest surviving pre-WW1 passenger steamer.

properties.name: Fortress of Louisbourg
properties.street: 7495 Main St, Louisbourg, NS B1C 1H6, Canada
properties.description: Louisbourg Fortress protected France's access to its American colonies to the Atlantic - making it the key to its defensive colonial presence in North America. The Fortress was captured by the British - twice. The Fortress has now been rebuilt and acts as a living history museum. This isn't just a fortress, it's an entire fortified town - one of the few of its kind in North America.

properties.name: Alexander Graham Bell National Historic Site
properties.street: 559 Chebucto St, Baddeck, NS B0E 1B0, Canada
properties.description: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone - and used his monopoly on the service to fund his other scientific experiments at his mansion in Nova Scotia: hydrofoils, aircraft, and kites so large they could carry people into the sky. All of those inventions and more are right here at the Alexander Graham Bell National Historic Site.

properties.name: Cape Breton Highlands National Park
properties.description: The mountains meet the sea at Cape Breton Highlands National Park. While you can hike the highlands themselves, the Cabot Trail Road follows most of the park so you can see it from your car.

properties.name: Site historique maritime de la Pointe-au-Père
properties.street: 1034 Rue du Phare, Rimouski, QC G5M 1L8, Canada
properties.description: It's ships and shipwrecks - French Canada style. The Cold War era Oberon-class submarine HMCS Onondaga is here on display, along with museums dedicated to the nearby 1914 sinking of the RMS Empress of Ireland where 1,012 people died, and the Pointe-au-Pere lighthouse.

properties.name: Musée Maritime du Québec
properties.street: 63 Chem. des Pionniers E, L'Islet, QC G0R 2B0, Canada
properties.description: This museum possesses the Cold-War era experimental high speed military hydrofoil HMCS Bras d'Or and the icebreaker CCGS Ernest Lapointe.

properties.name: Citadelle of Quebec
properties.street: 1 Côte de la Citadelle, Québec, QC G1R 3R2, Canada
properties.description: The British built a massive fortress atop sheer cliffs at the mouth of the strategically important St. Lawrence River. During its operation, this was thought of as the Gibraltar of North America.

properties.name: Chaudière Falls (Chaudière River)
properties.street: 3300 Rue du Parc-des-Chutes, Lévis, QC G6X 1K8, Canada
properties.description: Near Quebec City lays a 115ft high waterfall that pours into a gorge. You can see the waterfall best from the pedestrian suspension bridge spanning the gorge, there's also some nice trails nearby.

properties.name: Montreal Biodome
properties.street: 4777 Pierre-de Coubertin Ave, Montreal, Quebec H1V 1B3, Canada
properties.description: The Montreal Biodome is a combine zoo-botanical garden where you can walk through the same habitat the zoo animals live in

properties.name: Prince Edward Island National Park
properties.street: 41 Dalvay Crescent, Dalvay by the Sea, PE C0A 1P0, Canada
properties.description: It's soaring sand dunes with red cliffs on the beaches of Prince Edward Island. It's basically Canadian Delaware.

properties.name: Green Gables (Prince Edward Island)
properties.street: 8779 PE-6, New Glasgow, PE C0A 1N0, Canada
properties.description: This is THE Green Gables from the popular book Ann of Green Gables. They also built a replica of the fictional town of Avonlea nearby. If you have no idea why people like Ann of Green Gables, it's because it was one of the few books depicting a quirky female protagonist until contemporary literature. Even if you aren't a fan, you can watch people who act like Ann of Green Gables is a cult which is entertaining in itself.

properties.name: Fundy National Park
properties.description: The Bay of Fundy features the most dramatic tides in the world - 49ft every day and night. If the trails covering rugged coastline and perilous tides don't impress you, the 25 waterfalls will. The highest waterfall is nearly 52ft high.

properties.name: Hopewell Rocks Provincial Park
properties.street: 131 Discovery Rd, Hopewell Cape, NB E4H 4Z5, Canada
properties.description: The 50ft tides of the Bay of Fundy have carved this sandstone into perilous sea stacks. At low tide, you can walk all the way up to the base.

properties.name: Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21
properties.street: 1055 Marginal Rd, Halifax, NS B3H 4P7, Canada
properties.description: If you are Canadian, there's a good chance your ancestors showed up at this immigration pier in Halifax - you can even look up your family's immigration information and take it home. See how the people of the world become Canadian, or get sent back.

properties.name: Maritime Museum of the Atlantic
properties.street: 1675 Lower Water St, Halifax, NS B3J 1S3, Canada
properties.description: One ship such as the ocean surveying ship CSS Acadia is usually enough to justify a maritime museum. The Maritime Museum of the Atlantic has 70+ additional small craft and is right next to the WW2 era Flower-class corvette HMCS Sackville. There's also a Titanic exhibit with artifacts.

properties.name: Forillon National Park
properties.street: 1238 Boul de Forillon, Gaspé, QC G4X 6T9, Canada
properties.description: The vertical white cliffs of the Appalachians meets the Atlantic Ocean at land's end. There's waterfalls and mountains and trails to hike all of it. A lot of the park is driveable, but the best views await those who hike.

properties.name: Anticosti National Park
properties.street: 25 Chem. des Forestiers, Port-Menier, QC G0G 2Y0, Canada
properties.description: The remote island of Anticosti is home to deep canyons and massive waterfalls - the only problem is the ferry only runs once a week, and the car rentals are almost always reserved. Chute Vaureal is the largest and most photographed waterfall on the island.

properties.name: Mingan Archipelago National Park Reserve
properties.street: 1010 Promenade Des Anciens, Havre-Saint-Pierre, QC G0G 1P0, Canada
properties.description: The coast of the Mingan archipelago has been carved into fossil covered monoliths. You'll need to book a sea excursion to see any of it though.

properties.name: Grasslands National Park
properties.street: 101 Centre St, Val Marie, SK S0N 2T0, Canada
properties.description: You'd think a name like Grasslands National Park would imply that this park is all flat grasslands - nope- it's all badlands. Stand on top of 70 mile Butte and see for yourself.

properties.name: Western Development Museum Saskatoon
properties.street: 2610 Lorne Ave, Saskatoon, SK S7J 0S6, Canada
properties.description: The building's outside may look demure, but they fit an entire town inside of it. Complete with trains, a collection of cars, agricultural machinery, and a fun house. During Christmas time they put up an exhibit with terrifying 1940s animatronic dolls. The museum just keeps going, it is seemingly without end.

properties.name: Prince of Wales Fort
properties.street: Prince of Wales Fort, Churchill, MB R0B 0E0, Canada
properties.description: It's a fortress on the edge of the world. There was nothing around it when Prince of Wales Fort was built next to Hudson Bay in 1731, there was nothing around it when it destroyed by the French in 1782, and there remains nearly nothing around the ruins to this day. There's a tour boat from nearby Churchill that runs to it.

properties.name: Marine Museum of Manitoba
properties.street: 444 Eveline St, Selkirk, MB R1A 1E6, Canada
properties.description: 6 ships are now a museum on dry land in the middle of Manitoba. Lake Winnipeg and the Red River drain into Hudson Bay, which means despite being in the middle of the Canadian Prairie, Manitoba relied on ships as its main form of transportation.

properties.name: Manitoba Museum
properties.street: 190 Rupert Ave, Winnipeg, MB R3B 0N2, Canada
properties.description: Manitoba History, from dinosaurs to the Europeans. There's a full sized replica of the sailing ship that founded the Hudson's Bay Company inside this museum.

properties.name: Silver Falls Provincial Park
properties.street: c/o Kakabeka Falls Provincial Park Box 252, 4853 Hwy 11/17 Kakabeka Falls, ON P0T 1W0
properties.description: Dog Lake spills towards Lake Superior via a series of waterfalls, including the stepped Dog Falls and the canyon-like Silver Falls.

properties.name: Kakabeka Falls Provincial Park
properties.street: 4853 ON-11 #17, Kakabeka Falls, ON P0T 1W0, Canada
properties.description: This is Ontario's second biggest waterfall after Niagara Falls, at 130ft, it too plunges into a gorge - however this one isn't as commercialized.

properties.name: CCGS Alexander Henry
properties.street: 2446 Marina Park, Sleeping Giant PKWY Thunder Bay, ON, Canada, Ontario P7A 0E7
properties.description: During the winter, the surface of the Great Lakes freezes - the solution? Icebreakers. The CCGS Alexander Henry supplied lighthouses, provided search and rescue services, and shattered ice so navigation could continue on the inland seas.

properties.name: Playland (Vancouver)
properties.street: 2901 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5K 5J1, Canada
properties.description: Playland is Canada's oldest operating amusement park, operating since 1910. It's like a permanent fair - but with better rides such as the 1958 Wooden Roller Coaster.

properties.name: Okanagan Desert
properties.description: There is a tiny desert surrounded by verdant green forests in the mountains of British Columbia. This is Canada's only semi-arid shrubland desert - the rest of the country is quite cold. The best way to see the desert is at the Nk'Mip Desert Cultural Centre and Osoyoos Desert Centre

properties.name: Banff Springs Hotel
properties.street: 405 Spray Ave, Banff, AB T1L 1J4, Canada
properties.description: The Banff Springs Hotel is a historic grand railway hotel perched on a hill overlooking Bow Falls, Tunnel Mountain, Mount Rundle, and a scenic valley between them.

properties.name: Banff National Park
properties.street: 201 Village Rd, Lake Louise, AB T0L 1E0, Canada
properties.description: Glaciers roll off the scenic rocky mountains into incredibly blue lakes, canyons, waterfalls, and rapids. Johnston Canyon, Lake Louise, and Lake Morraine are all fantastic stops with great hikes that show off the beauty of the Canadian Rockies. The park gets crowded - even during off season. Fortunately you can take in most of the beauty of the mountains along the road. Icefields Parkway is one of the most beautiful drives in existence.

properties.name: Jasper National Park
properties.street: 500 Connaught Dr, Jasper, AB T0E 0A8, Canada
properties.description: Even more glaciers, even more Rocky Mountains, even more waterfalls, and even more glacial lakes. Unlike Banff, Jasper is truly remote in the mountains - it's the only major city for 100+ miles. You can hike on glaciers and all throughout the park - but be careful, help is far far away.

properties.name: Yoho National Park
properties.street: 5764 Trans - Canada Hwy, Field, BC V0A 1L0, Canada
properties.description: Yoho National Park is centered around the western slope of the continental divide. The main road into the park is closed during the winter, but when it is open you can see the wonders of glaciers, 991ft waterfalls, a lake that has emerald green water, and fast river rapids. This place gets just as busy as Banff during the summer, so plan ahead.

properties.name: Waterton Lakes National Park
properties.street: 404 Cameron Falls Dr, Waterton Park, AB T0K 0C3, Canada
properties.description: The Rockies of Canada never stop being beautiful. What makes this National Park unique though is its clear view of the plains, the rainbow streams and frighteningly red rocks of Red Rock Canyon, red mountains, and the large lake framing all of it. Get in some hiking - this is one of the less popular of the Canadian Rocky parks.

properties.name: Reynolds Museum
properties.description: Successful used-vehicle salesman Stan Reynolds hoarded machinery and vehicles and created the Reynolds Museum. The museum includes staggeringly large power shovels, 350+ agricultural machines, 530+ cars,  135+ aircraft, and 450+ industrial artifacts. There's so many artifacts they don't even all fit in the museum - you need to take a warehouse tour in July and August to see them.

properties.name: Kootenay National Park
properties.street: 7556 Main St E, Radium Hot Springs, BC V0A 1M0, Canada
properties.description: Kootenay National Park stands out among the Canadian Rockies due to its hot springs at Radium Springs. The park follows the waterfalls, lakes, and valleys of the Kootenay River and Vermillion River. The hikes at Kootenay are a bit less accessible than nearby Banff, you can see most of the beauty from the Kootenay Highway.

properties.name: SS Moyie
properties.street: 324 Front St, Kaslo, BC V0G 1M0, Canada
properties.description: This is the oldest paddle steamer in the world. Large paddlewheel steamers used to be the only way to move goods up and down the remote waters of the Canadian Rockies. The SS Moyie plied Kootenay Lake from 1898-1957, and is now available to tour.

properties.name: Glacier National Park (Canada)
properties.street: 9520 Trans - Canada Hwy, Rogers Pass, BC V0E 2S0, Canada
properties.description: Like the other National Parks in the Canadian Rockies, Glacier National Park offers stunning glaciers, waterfalls, and mountains. However, this park is less accessible than Banff or Jasper. Most of the hiking available in Glacier National Park is in the Rogers Pass and Illecillewaet Valley Area - where you can hike up to the crest of the Glaciers.

properties.name: Mount Revelstoke National Park
properties.street: Meadows in the Sky Pkwy, Revelstoke, BC V0E 2S0, Canada
properties.description: Mount Revelstoke National Park's claim to fame in the Canadian Rocky National Park system is that the mountain itself is easily climbable because they built a road to the top. From the top of Mt Revelstoke you can embark on hikes to the lakes, rivers, and waterfalls of the rest of the park.

properties.name: SS Sicamous
properties.street: 1099 Lakeshore Dr W, Penticton, BC V2A 1B7, Canada
properties.description: The 1914 Paddle Steamer SS Sicamous was a luxury passenger vessel on Okanagan Lake. Think of it as the Titanic of the Rockies but still afloat - the interior is all Mahogany and Teak. The ship is parked next to the tugboat SS Naramata, Canadian National No.6 Tug Boat, and the stern saloon of the SS Okanagan.

properties.name: Vancouver Maritime Museum
properties.street: 1905 Ogden Ave, Vancouver, BC V6J 1A3, Canada
properties.description: The Vancouver Maritime Museum possesses the St. Roch, the first ship to complete the Northwest Passage from west to east in 1940. It's like the Canadian version of the Fram Museum. There's also a submarine here, a model ship made out of bones, so so many scale models, and you can try on an old timey diver's helmet.

properties.name: Royal British Columbia Museum
properties.street: 675 Belleville St., Victoria, BC V8W 9W2, Canada
properties.description: Featuring a partial full scale model of the HMS Discovery - the ship that discovered British Columbia, a re-creation of what Victoria was like during the 1900s and a First Nations Big House complete with Totem Poles, and a natural history museum.

properties.name: Strathcona Provincial Park
properties.street: Strathcona Park Wilderness Centre Nordic Dr, Comox-Strathcona C, BC V9H 1B4, Canada
properties.description: Strathcona Provincial Park covers the snowcapped mountains of Vancouver Island. The park is actually a temperate rainforest full of hiking trails to glaciers, waterfalls - including the 1,440ft tall Della Falls, and lakes. This is also home of the critically endangered and very cute Vancouver Island Marmot.

properties.name: Pacific Rim National Park Reserve
properties.street: 485 Wick Rd, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0, Canada
properties.description: Temperate rainforests and mountains line the beaches of Vancouver Island. It's a hiking and kayaking paradise. The park is broken down into three units: the easily accessible by car Long Beach Unit, and the only accessible by boat Broken Group Islands Unit, and the only accessible by hiking West Coast Trail Unit.

properties.name: Kananaskis Country
properties.description: Hiking through the waterfalls, glaciers, mountains, valleys, and rapids of the Canadian Rockies continue at the K-country park system. Kananaskis Country is Alberta's Provincial Park System for the Canadian Rockies, and consists of 9 parks accessible by road: Peter Lougheed Provincial Park, Bow Valley Provincial Park, Sheep River Provincial Park, Spray Valley Provincial Park, Bluerock Wildland Provincial Park, Bow Valley Wildland Provincial Park, Don Getty Wildland Provincial Park, Elbow-Sheep Wildland Provincial Park, and the ski courses of Canmore Nordic Centre Provincial Park.

properties.name: Mount Robson Provincial Park
properties.street: BC-16, Mount Robson, BC V0E 2Z0, Canada
properties.description: Mount Robson Provincial Park is Jasper National Park's sibling, it's best known for the Berg Lake Trail which takes you to the Valley of a Thousand Falls - a rocky canyon with towering glacier capped mountains on every side.

properties.name: Wells Gray Provincial Park
properties.street: 416 Eden Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N1, Canada
properties.description: It's even more waterfalls, rapids, glaciers, mountains, and river valleys in the Canadian Rockies. Wells Gray Provincial Park is accessed via Clearwater Valley Road, which follows the river and the 42 beautiful waterfalls along it. Some waterfalls are over 600ft tall, with Helmcken and Spahats Falls being particularly picturesque.

properties.name: Writing-on-Stone Provincial Park
properties.street: NW 36 TW1 range 13, Milk River, AB T0K 1M0, Canada
properties.description: The winding path through the hoodoos here is carved with petroglyphs.

properties.name: Sandbanks Provincial Park
properties.street: 3004 County Rd 12, Picton, ON K0K 2T0, Canada
properties.description: Lake Michigan isn't the only Great Lake with sand dunes. At Sandbanks Provincial Park, sand dunes act as barriers to bays on the shore of Lake Ontario. What makes these sand dunes different is that they extend as a long spit out into the lake, instead of just hugging the lakeshore.

properties.name: Shannon Falls Provincial Park
properties.street: British Columbia 97, Squamish-Lillooet D, BC V0N 1T0, Canada
properties.description: Shannon Falls is a 1,099ft waterfall sliding off the mountainside into the temperate rainforest. You can hike up to get a good look at the falls, it is so big that it is hard to miss from afar though.

properties.name: Garibaldi Provincial Park
properties.street: British Columbia 99, Brackendale, BC V0N 1H0, Canada
properties.description: Hike to the top of a mountain to find a bright blue glacial lake, and even more mountains covered in glaciers rising above you. There are multiple trailheads into the park, however, Rubble Creek Trailhead takes you to Garibaldi Lake and is the most accessible trailhead to the park.

properties.name: Joffre Lakes Provincial Park
properties.street: Joffre Lake Trail Parking, Lytton, BC V0K 1Z0, Canada
properties.description: Hike up a mountainside to see a turquoise glacial lake with glaciers directly feeding it. This park is easy to hike to, and is close to Vancouver, so it gets busy in the summer.

properties.name: Bugaboo Provincial Park
properties.street: Bugaboo Provincial Park Highway 95, Parson, BC V0A 1L0, Canada
properties.description: The Glaciers on the mountains of Bugaboo Provincial Park are accessible from trails reached from Bugaboo Creek Road. You will need a high-clearance vehicle to use the roads though. Otherwise it's a less busy park with hikes straight to the glaciers and their glacial lakes. .

properties.name: Pinawa Dam Provincial Heritage Park
properties.description: Manitoba's first hydro-electric dam from 1906 is now abandoned in a park where you can crawl all over it as well as the rocky rapids in the river around it.

properties.name: Royal Canadian Artillery Museum
properties.street: 118 Patricia Rd Building N, Shilo, MB R0K 2A0, Canada
properties.description: Canadian Artillery has had to switch tactics from mobility in defending the wide plains of Canada to supporting trench warfare. Canadian artillery more closely follows British development compared to the United States - and this museum shows it from Confederation to Present. Accessing this museum requires entering a Canadian military base - so plan ahead.

properties.name: Canadian Railway Museum
properties.street: 110 Rue St Pierre, Saint-Constant, QC J5A 1G7, Canada
properties.description: This is THE Canadian Railway museum - and the largest railway museum in Canada period. The first railway in Canada was started nearby this site in 1836, and this museum chronicles railway development in Canada since then. The collection includes a replica of the 1848 locomotive John Molson, an A4 high speed steam locomotive, and 140 other pieces of rolling stock. There are historical train and streetcar demonstrations daily during the summer.

properties.name: Chute Montmorency
properties.street: 5300 Bd Sainte-Anne, Québec, QC G1C 0M3, Canada
properties.description: This 272 ft tall waterfall is taller than Niagara Falls, and has a pedestrian suspension bridge that takes you right near the edge of it, a promenade that will take you right to the base, and trails that will take you around the rim.

properties.name: SS Keno
properties.street: 1025 Front St, Dawson City, YT Y0B 0A3, Canada
properties.description: This 1922 paddle steamer transported ore along the treacherous shifting waters of the Yukon river until the highways arrived. Now it is still here in the remote Yukon as a museum ship.

properties.name: Pioneer Park (Fairbanks)
properties.description: The remains of the Alaska 67 Centennial Exposition have been repurposed into a museum complex showing off Alaskan history. This includes the 1933 sternwheeler SS Nenana (the second longest wooden boat in existence), A narrow gauge railroad museum that encircles the park, a replica native village, air museum, an actual Gold Rush Boomtown, and mini golf.

properties.name: Chugach State Park
properties.description: 495,204 acres of mountains, glaciers, ice fields, and beautiful flowing rivers of the Alaskan frontier that you can actually access via trail and car.

properties.name: Kenai Fjords National Park
properties.description: Massive glaciers have carved the mountains into scenic fjords. You can only see the fjords from the ocean from a tour boat (there are tours from nearby Seward), but you can see a glacier at the Exit Glacier Nature Center via car.

properties.name: Wrangell–St. Elias National Park and Preserve
properties.street: Kennecot Visitor Center, McCarthy Rd, Chitina, AK 99566
properties.description: This is America's largest national park, covering the mountains and glaciers of the second tallest mountains in the United States. The glaciers and mountains are littered with the remains of abandoned mines which are accessible by trail. You can actually get to most of the park along the McCarthy Road which will take you to abandoned mines at the base of a glacier. Nabesna road provides access to valleys on the north end of the park.

properties.name: Denali National Park
properties.street: Park Rd, Denali National Park and Preserve, AK 99755
properties.description: Mount McKinley (AKA Denali) is America's tallest mountain at 20,310ft tall. The glacier covered mountain dwarfs all other mountains surrounding it. Access to the park's main road and trails along it requires boarding a bus at the Denali Visitor Center, no private vehicles are allowed, it's a 5 hour round trip minimum. Cars can only go as far as the Savage River trailhead during the summer - so plan ahead.

properties.name: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
properties.street: 525 Ocean Blvd, Blackpool FY4 1EZ, United Kingdom
properties.description: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is home to historic rollercoasters that are some of the oldest in the United Kingdom, including the 1923 Big Dipper, the 1933 Rollercoaster, the 1934 Blue Flyer, and the dueling coaster Grand National from 1935. Also features is the one of a kind Steeplechase where you race upon horse shaped cars with very few restraints. The park itself is a marvel of engineering, with the rides being aggressively stacked on top of each other.

properties.name: Great Yarmouth Pleasure Beach
properties.street: The Pleasure Beach, S Beach Parade, Great Yarmouth NR30 3EH, United Kingdom
properties.description: Great Yarmouth Pleasure Beach is home to the 1932 Roller Coaster - one of the few remaining scenic railway type rollercoasters.

properties.name: RRS Discovery
properties.street: Discovery Point, Riverside Dr, Dundee DD1 4XA, United Kingdom
properties.description: The 1901 Discovery Expedition jumpstarted modern exploration and development of Antarctica. The RRS Discovery was built specifically to get to and operate in Antarctic waters. You can now tour the drydocked museum ship at Discovery Point and learn about the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration.

properties.name: National Museum of Flight
properties.street: East Fortune Airfield, B1347, East Fortune, North Berwick EH39 5LF, United Kingdom
properties.description: A WW2 RAF air base has been preserved and stuffed full of historic aircraft, including: Avro Blue Steel Standoff and Blue Streak nuclear missiles, a Concorde (you can go inside it!), a de Havilland Comet, and Avro Vulcan.

properties.name: Discovery Museum
properties.street: Discovery Museum, Blandford Square, Newcastle upon Tyne NE1 4JA, United Kingdom
properties.description: It's a local history museum, but it includes the Turbinia - the first modern steam turbine vessel.

properties.name: National Museum of the Royal Navy, Hartlepool
properties.street: Jackson Dock, Maritime Ave, Hartlepool TS24 0XZ, United Kingdom
properties.description: The Hartlepool branch of the National Museum of the Royal Navy has been built to resemble a re-creation of a 18th century seaport, and it has the 1812 sailing frigate HMS Trincomalee to match. The 1934 paddlesteamer PS Wingfield Castle is also available for tour.

properties.name: Lake District National Park
properties.description: England's largest national park is full of hiking trails over mountains with lakes, waterfalls, and castles in between them.

properties.name: National Railway Museum (York)
properties.street: National Railway Museum, Leeman Rd, York YO26 4XJ, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE Railway museum in the United Kingdom - well half of it, the other half is at Locomotion in Shildon. The modern steam engine and railroading were invented in the United Kingdom, and as a result the National Railway Museum captures that development in its collection. There are 100 trains here, including: The Flying Scotsman, the streamlined Duchess of Hamilton, the A4 Mallard, Stephenson's Rocket, a Shinkansen, and an APT. The collection here shuffles between museums, so check ahead if you want to see something in particular.

properties.name: Locomotion Museum
properties.street: Dale Road Industrial Estate, Shildon DL4 2RE, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is the other half of the National Railway Museum - THE museum for railroading in the United Kingdom. The museum features historical locomotives such as the 1825 Locomotion, the Battle of Britain-Class Winston Churchill, the prototype High Speed Train, and the fastest diesel locomotive ever built - the British Rail Class 43. Check in advance if you are going here, they shuffle trains between museums and workshops.

properties.name: Blackpool Tower
properties.street: The Blackpool Tower, Promenade, Blackpool FY1 4BJ, United Kingdom
properties.description: Following the construction of the Eiffel Tower, other countries wanted their own very tall tower. The Blackpool Tower is an 1894 knockoff of the Eiffel Tower, but it features an old dance hall in fairly good condition.

properties.name: Portsmouth Historic Dockyard
properties.street: Victory Gate, HM Naval Base, Portsea, Portsmouth PO1 3LJ, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE English naval history museum complex telling the story of the Navy that once ruled the mightiest empire in human history. Featuring: The salvaged wreckage of the 1510 carrack Mary Rose, the 1758 Ship of the Line HMS Victory - Admiral Nelson's flagship at the battle of Trafalgar in 1805, HMS Warrior - the world's first iron-hulled warship from 1860; the National Museum of the Royal Navy; the Royal Navy Submarine Museum featuring the Royal Navy's first submarine Holland 1, the submarine killer HMS Alliance, and German and English midget submarine; and the Museum of Naval Firepower.

properties.name: Stonehenge
properties.description: In prehistory local peoples built a megalith of standing stones from 2600BC to 2400BC

properties.name: Royal Navy Fleet Air Arm Museum
properties.street: Royal Navy Fleet Air Arm Museum, RNAS Yeovilton, Ilchester BA22 8HT, United Kingdom
properties.description: The Royal Navy has been launching aircraft off of boats since 1912, and used them to devastating advantage in WW1, WW2, and the Falklands War. One of the hangars here has even been converted into a mockup of a fleet carrier. Trace the history of British naval aviation from the very beginning. Notable aircraft include: a de Haviland Sea Vixen, BAC 221, and the BAC Concorde.

properties.name: SS Great Britain
properties.street: Great Western Dockyard, Gas Ferry Rd, Bristol BS1 6TY, United Kingdom
properties.description: The SS Great Britain was the world's largest passenger ship when it was launched in 1845, and paved the way for all modern iron hull steam powered vessels to follow - thus beginning the age of transatlantic steamship travel. Now you can tour it as it was.

properties.name: Aerospace Bristol
properties.street: Aerospace Bristol Hayes Way, Patchway, Bristol BS34 5BZ, United Kingdom
properties.description: Aerospace Bristol mostly covers the history of aircraft from local aircraft manufacturer Bristol Aeroplane Company, which later became part of BAE Systems. The museum also features a BAC Concorde - which has roughly the same cultural relevance to the British as the Space Shuttle does to the United States.

properties.name: Big Pit National Coal Museum
properties.street: Big Pit National Coal Museum, Pontypool NP4 9XP, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is the Welsh coal mining museum. Britain got a head start on the industrial revolution thanks to its generous coal deposits in mines just like this one. Tour an 1860 coal mine that operated until the end of coal mining in Britain and see machinery from all eras. You can't go into the mine itself here.

properties.name: National Coal Mining Museum for England
properties.street: Caphouse Colliery, New Rd, Overton, Wakefield WF4 4RH, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE British coal mining museum. Learn about English coal mining at this pit which operated from 1770s-1985. The museum is old and extensively covers the history of mining in England, has a bunch of coal mining railway locomotives, and more importantly they let you go into the mine on tours (reserved ahead of time).

properties.name: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
properties.street: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker, Hack House, Lane CW5 8BL, United Kingdom
properties.description: The United Kingdom built bunkers to allow continuity of government in the event of nuclear armageddon. Now you can tour this bunker and learn about what the British expected of a nuclear war.

properties.name: National Motor Museum, Beaulieu
properties.street: John Montagu Building, Beaulieu, Brockenhurst SO42 7ZN, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE British car museum. Featuring 250+ cars from all of British history, including the vehicles from British media such a James Bond, Chitty Chitty Bang Bang, and Mr. Bean; a monorail, and vehicles from historical British automotive manufacturers.

properties.name: The Tank Museum
properties.street: R A C Tank Museum, Linsay Rd, Bovington, Wareham BH20 6JG, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE British tank museum. 300+ tanks and armored vehicles from every war that the British have used tanks in. This includes some rarity tanks such as the the first ever British tank Little Willie, Vickers A1E1 Independent; the Mark I, IV, V, VIII, and IX; Tog II, Char B1, and so so many more from WW1 to Afghanistan.

properties.name: Alton Towers
properties.street: Alton Towers Farley Ln, Alton, Stoke-on-Trent ST10 4DB, United Kingdom
properties.description: Alton Towers contains a collection of some of the most unique rollercoasters in the world. Including an inverted rollercoaster built into trenches in the ground, the rollercoaster with 14 inversions - the most ever built, a rollercoaster that dives 50ft underground, and a wooden rollercoaster with flame effects.

properties.name: Imperial War Museum Duxford
properties.street: Imperial War Museum Duxford, IWM Duxford Airfield, Cambridge CB22 4QR, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE British Aviation museum - spanning 4 hangars with over 200+ aircraft spanning all of British military history. Notable aircraft include: the BAC TSR.2, BAC Concorde, Handley Page Victor, Avro Shackleton, SR-71 Blackbird, and a bunch of British passenger aircraft when the British still had an industry that did that.

properties.name: Royal Air Force Museum Midlands
properties.street: Royal Air Force Museum Midlands, Lysander Ave, Cosford, Shifnal TF11 8UP, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is the other half of the Royal Air Force Museum. Featuring: a lot of nuclear missiles -including the Polaris and Thor, a BAC TSR-2, an Avro Vulcan, and the Vickers Valiant that dropped Britain's first hydrogen bomb, and 70+ other aircraft.

properties.name: Brooklands Museum
properties.street: Brooklands Museum, Brooklands Dr, Weybridge KT13 0SL, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE British bus museum. Brooklands was home to a many early British aviation and automotive manufacturers - which is why it this location contains the London Bus museum, various racecars, as well as some notable aircraft such as: the BAC Concorde, and Vickers Vimy.

properties.name: Royal Air Force Museum London
properties.street: Royal Air Force Museum London, Grahame Park Way, London NW9 5LL, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is THE Royal Air Force Museum. 6 hangars full of Royal Air Force History with 90+ aircraft covering just about every aircraft ever used in the RAF. Featuring rare aircraft such as the F-35, Short Sunderland flying boat, Avro Vulcan, and various rare flying boats. If you want to see a full history of British aviation, go to Imperial War Museum Duxford.

properties.name: The British Museum
properties.street: The British Museum Great Russell St, London WC1B 3DG, United Kingdom
properties.description: This is one of the best history and art museums on the planet. The British Empire at its height controlled 24% of the world and 23% of the global population - the largest empire in human history - which means they pilfered a lot of really cool artifacts. Including, the Rosetta Stone, a bunch of Ancient Egyptian statues, entire Greek temples, the carvings from the Parthenon, various roman tombs, everything nice from Assyrian palaces, Easter Island Rapa Nui Statues, and paintings and artifacts from the entire planet.

properties.name: Imperial War Museum London
properties.street: Imperial War Museum, Lambeth Rd, London SE1 6HZ, United Kingdom
properties.description: Existing in the European thunderdome and having a globe spanning empire means the British have been at war a lot. This museum however focuses on WW1 to present. If you want to see more military equipment, go to Imperial War Museum Duxford.

properties.name: Tower of London
properties.street: Tower of London, London EC3N 4AB, United Kingdom
properties.description: When the Normans conquered England in 1066, they built the Tower of London in 1078 in the heart of the largest city as a fortress and prison to enforce their rule on the conquered peoples. The Tower of London was the center of British power until the English Civil War shifted power to parliament in 1651. The crown jewels are stored here, and are available for viewing.

properties.name: HMS Belfast
properties.street: HMS Belfast, The Queen's Walk, London SE1 2JH, United Kingdom
properties.description: The WW2 era Town-class cruiser HMS Belfast is the largest British warship that remains from the time when Britain's navy was the largest in the world. The ship saw service in WW2 and Korea.

properties.name: Kelvedon Hatch Secret Nuclear Bunker
properties.street: Kelvedon Hatch, Brentwood CM15 0LA, United Kingdom
properties.description: Located beneath a bungalow is a bunker designed to resist nuclear attack for the purpose of continuity of government in the event of a nuclear holocaust. Preparing for the end of the world will always be cool until the world actually ends.

properties.name: Edinburgh Castle
properties.street: Edinburgh Castle Castlehill, Edinburgh EH1 2NG, United Kingdom
properties.description: This fortress built on top of an extinct volcano has been the center of power in Scotland for 1,100 years. Not only is it a fortress, but also a palace, National War Museum, and National War Memorial.

properties.name: HMY Britannia
properties.street: HMY Britannia Ocean Dr, Leith, Edinburgh EH6 6JJ, United Kingdom
properties.description: This royal yacht is one of the only palaces on water, and served from 1954 to 1997.

properties.name: Titanic Belfast
properties.street: 1 Olympic Wy, Belfast BT3 9EP, United Kingdom
properties.description: The White Star Line ship RMS Titanic was built in Belfast and was the largest ocean liner in the world when is struck an iceberg and killed a bunch of rich people onboard. The museum features the last surviving White Star Line vessel SS Nomadic as well as history about the ill-fated passenger liner.

properties.name: Tokyo Imperial Palace
properties.description: The Imperial Palace is a massive palace and garden complex located in the heart of Tokyo and has been the seat of power for the Emperor since the Meiji Restoration in 1867

properties.name: Meiji-mura
properties.description: Meiji-Mura is a architectural museum where 67 significant buildings have been moved or reconstructed. The general idea is to replicate the Meiji period when Japan opened itself to the outside world after centuries of isolation. The centerpiece is a re-creation of Frank Lloyd Wright's Imperial Hotel

properties.name: Japanese battleship Mikasa
properties.description: The pre-dreadnought Mikasa is the last surviving pre WW1 battleship, and was the flagship of Admiral Togo during the Battle of Tsushima - the most decisive battleship to battleship engagement of all time.

properties.name: Tokyo Dome City Attractions
properties.street: 1 Chome-3-61 Koraku, Bunkyo City, Tokyo 112-8575, Japan
properties.description: It's an amusement park located on top of a city block in the heart of the most populous urban area in the world. Featuring a 260ft rollercoaster that dives through a Ferris wheel and encircles the complex.

properties.name: Nagashima Spa Land
properties.description: Nagashima Spa Land has always aimed to build unique rollercoasters, including: Steel Dragon 2000 - which opened as the tallest rollercoaster in the world at 318ft, and Hakugei renowned as one of the greatest rollercoasters of all time. There are 13 rollercoasters in total here.

properties.name: Hikawa Maru
properties.street: Japan, 〒231-0023 Kanagawa, Yokohama, Naka Ward, Yamashitacho, 山下公園地先
properties.description: Come walk aboard a 1930s art deco Japanese luxury ocean liner.

properties.name: Ghibli Museum
properties.description: Come see the works of famed Japanese animation Studio Ghibli come to life in 3 dimensions at the Ghibli Museum. It's all the whimsical architecture and design from the films but in real life and in higher detail. You need to buy tickets a month ahead of time - so plan ahead.

properties.name: Railway Museum (Saitama)
properties.street: Japan, 〒330-0852 Saitama, Omiya Ward, Onaricho, 3 Chome−４７
properties.description: This is East Japan Railway Company's museum. Learn about the development of Japanese railways from the first steam locomotive in Japan in 1871 to the modern day bullet trains. There's 30+ trains here with an example of a train from every era. There's also miniature train you can drive yourself, and elaborate model railroads.

properties.name: SCMaglev and Railway Park
properties.street: 3 Chome-2-2 Kinjofuto, Minato Ward, Nagoya, Aichi 455-0848, Japan
properties.description: This is Japanese Railway Corporation Central Japan Railway Company's museum, and they like to show off their highest speed trains: including one that levitates on magnets, 12 Shinkansen high speed trains, and a series of electric railcars and steam locomotives.

properties.name: Kyoto Railway Museum
properties.street: Kyoto Railway Museum, Kankijicho, Shimogyo Ward, Kyoto, 600-8835, Japan
properties.description: This is West Japan Railway Company's museum, and it's the biggest of all of the major railway museums in Japan. Featuring a former train station, roundhouse; display hall; and 53+ pieces of rolling stock from 1880s steam locomotives to modern Shinkansen, and everything in between.

properties.name: Fuji-Q Highland
properties.description: An amusement park with stunning views of Mount Fuji, featuring two hypercoasters (including a 4th dimensional one), and 6 rollercoasters in total.

properties.name: Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park
properties.street: Mount Fuji Kitayama, Fujinomiya, Shizuoka 418-0112, Japan
properties.description: The active stratovolcano Mount Fuji rises 12,389ft above the plains surrounding it. You can hike to the top of this especially prominent mountain, and there are hotels and roadways that will help you get halfway to the blackened rim of the caldera.

properties.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum
properties.description: On August 6, 1945 Hiroshima became the first city to be bathed in nuclear fire. See artifacts (including the carbon shadows of humans vaporized by the blast), reconstructions, the still standing remains of the Industrial Promotion Hall, and documentation of what nuclear armageddon has in store for us all.

properties.name: Vasa Museum
properties.description: See a nearly fully intact shipwreck. The 17th century warship Vasa sunk on its maiden voyage in the cold waters of Stockholm harbor, and was raised nearly entirely intact in 1961, and restored so that you can tour it. It is the only intact 17th century sailing vessel in existence. The museum also features 4 other museum ships: the ice breaker Sankt Erik, the lightvessel Finngrundet, the torpedo boat Spica, and the rescue boat Bernhard Ingelsson.

properties.name: Gröna Lund
properties.description: Gröna Lund has been operating since 1883 in the middle of Stockholm. Forced with a space shortage, the park has had to engineer their rides to be stacked on top of each other - leading to unique designs for their 7 rollercoasters.

properties.name: Maritiman
properties.description: Sweden has always built its own ships for its historical policy of armed neutrality. The Maritiman museum features 10 of them, including the world's only coastal defense monitor, a Halland-class destroyer, and a Draken-class submarine. There's also a tugboat, ferry, fireboat, repair ship, and patrol boat.

properties.name: Marinmuseum
properties.description: This is THE Swedish naval museum. The Marinmuseum is the National Museum of the Swedish Navy, and features 7 ships, including Sweden's first submarine - the 1902 HMS Hajen, and the more modern Cold War era HSwMS Neptun, a tunnel that runs underwater to see the shipwreck of the 1684 warship Pins Carl, a reproduction of the gun deck of the frigate Dristigheten, a sailing ship, sloops, torpedo boat, minesweeper, and missile ship.

properties.name: Arsenalen
properties.description: This is THE Swedish tank museum. Sweden has always had its own independent tank manufacturing, and 75 such vehicles are shown off here (there are another 275+ kept off site). The vehicles cover Sweden's armored heritage from WW1 to present.

properties.name: Flygvapenmuseum
properties.description: The Flygvapenmuseum is the museum of the Swedish Air Force - and largely traces the history of SAAB as Sweden's principal aircraft manufacturer. Notable aircraft include the last Junkers Ju 86, as well as most Saab military aircraft up to the modern JAS 39 Gripen.

properties.name: Järnvägsmuseet
properties.description: The Järnvägsmuseet is Sweden's national railway museum - with over 100 locomotives adding up to 300+ vehicles total from the history of Swedish railroading. The trains are stored between the main museum and the nearby Tåghallen - transportation is provided between the two during the summer.

properties.name: Tivoli Gardens
properties.description: Tivoli is the second oldest amusement park in the world and features the 1914 Rutschebanen scenic railway style rollercoaster. There are 4 rollercoasters here in total in a mix of eclectic historic architecture in a sculptured garden setting.

properties.name: Dyrehavsbakken
properties.description: Bakken is the oldest amusement park in the world (est. 1583). However, the rides here are newer compared to nearby Tivoli Gardens, with the oldest rollercoaster having opened in 1932.

properties.name: Skibene på Holmen
properties.description: The historic ships at Holmen are 3 decommissioned Cold War era Danish naval ships located at a military base in the middle of Copenhagen. This includes the frigate FDMS Peder Skram, the coastal defense submarine HDMS Sælen, and a Williemose-class missile boat Sehested. These ships can only be visited during the summer during certain hours, so plan ahead.

properties.name: Regan Vest
properties.description: Regan Vest was Denmark's continuity of government bunker in the event of nuclear war. See how Denmark prepared for the apocalypse at this base 60 meters underground. You will have to buy a tour ahead of time - so plan ahead.

properties.name: Technik-Museum Speyer
properties.description: Tecknik-Museum Speyer is a sprawling complex showing off European vehicle manufacturing of trains, planes, boats, automobiles, and spacecraft. Notable features include Buran - the Soviet Union's version of the Space Shuttle, the Cold War Era German Submarine U-9, and the WW2 German midget submarines Biber and Seal, and the Museum Wilhelmsbau of weapons and mechanical musical instruments.

properties.name: Technik-Museum Sinsheim
properties.description: This is THE German vehicle museum. Technik-Museum Sinsheim is another sprawling museum complex displaying European vehicle manufacturing. Notably the museum has the BAC Concorde as well as the Tupolev Tu-144 (the Soviet Union's version of the Concorde), a DC-3 and the Illyushin Il-14 (the Soviet Union's Version of the DC-3), the Cold War Era German Submarine U-117, 300+ vintage cars, 40+ racecars, 200+ motorcycles, 27 locomotives, 60+ aircraft, 150+ tractors, some tanks, and a rollercoaster.

properties.name: Europa Park
properties.description: This is THE European amusement park. Europa Park has won the Golden Ticket Award's award for Best Theme Park in The World for 8 years in a row.  Featuring over 14 rollercoasters manufactured by the park's parent company Mack Rides, including the highly regarded Voltron - considered one of the best rollercoasters in the world.

properties.name: Zeppelin Museum Friedrichshafen
properties.description: The rigid airship was invented in Germany at the site of this museum. This museum features a reconstruction of the interiors of the largest zeppelin ever built - the LZ 129 Hindenburg, and actual wreckage from the airship.

properties.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
properties.description: King Ludwig of Bavaria deliberately built this castle to look like a fantasy painting in 1886. You need to buy your tickets online the day you wish to visit.

properties.name: Walhalla (memorial)
properties.description: Germany built its own version of the Parthenon in 1842 overlooking the Danube river as a hall of fame to great Germans.

properties.name: Völkerschlachtdenkmal
properties.description: Emperor Napoleon was defeated by the combined forces of Europe at the Battle of Leipzig in 1813, ending French domination of the European continent that had started under his reign. Half a million soldiers fought in the battle in total, and 92,000 of them became casualties. The monument to this battle was finished in 1913 and was intended to double as a crypt.

properties.name: Pergamonmuseum
properties.description: The Pergamonmuseum is a museum of antiquities, including reconstructions of the ancient Greek Pergamon Altar, the Roman Gatehouse of Miletus, the Babylonian Ishtar Gate, and the Jordanian Mshatta facade.

properties.name: Stasi Museum
properties.description: The East German Secret Police known as the Ministry for State Security had one informant for every six citizens of East Germany. Come learn about how the communists kept the former capitalist and nazi country repressed and aligned with the Eastern Bloc through psychological coercion and torture.

properties.name: Flugwerft Schleißheim
properties.description: Flugwerft Schleißheim is the aviation branch of the Deutsches Museum, featuring 60+ aircraft and gliders. This includes the Dornier Do 24 flying boat, the Horten HIV flying wing glider, the VTOL cargo aircraft Dornier Do 31, the VTOL EWR VJ 101 experimental aircraft, the VFW VAK 191B - the German attempt at building the  Harrier, and an Ariane 5 rocket booster.

properties.name: Deutsches Museum
properties.description: The Deutsches Museum is a science and technology museum, that notably has the U-1, the first submarine of the Imperial German Navy. There's also the first Benz Patent Motor Car, the first diesel engine, the first public television, and some planes and rockets.

properties.name: Militärhistorisches Museum der Bundeswehr
properties.description: The Bundeswehr Military History museum tells the story of German military history with a notable lack of emphasis of exhibits for the time period of 1914-1945. The German government's official stance is that they are very sorry and it won't happen again.

properties.name: Deutsches Panzermuseum Munster
properties.description: Unlike the Militärhistorisches Museum der Bundeswehr, the German Tank Museum is much more excited about their 80+ tanks from the period of 1917-1945 and think that armored vehicles from that time are really cool. Notable vehicles include a replica of the A7V, a Tiger II and just about every German tank from WW2 and the Cold War.

properties.name: Miniatur Wunderland
properties.description: This is the greatest scale model in the world. Do you like model trains? How about 1200+ of them? Even the planes, boats, and cars move too. There are 10 sections spanning the world and new ones are added every year. See tiny Germany, America, Scandinavia, Switzerland, Italy, Rio de Janeiro, Patagonia, Monaco, and France.

properties.name: Phantasialand
properties.description: Phantasialand is one of the best amusement parks worldwide. Known for its exceptional theming and 8 high quality rollercoasters, you will often need to reserve tickets in advance due to the popularity of the park.

properties.name: Verkehrsmuseum Nürnberg
properties.description: Verkehrsmuseum Nürnberg is the Nuremburg Branch of the DB Museum spread across two buildings. The museum features the luxury railcars of German royalty and Otto von Bismarck, the 1853 Nordgau - the oldest preserved locomotive in Germany, and the streamlined locomotive DR-Baureihe 05.

properties.name: KZ Buchenwald
properties.description: Buchenwald has the dishonorable mention of being used as a concentration camp by the Nazis where 56,545 people died, being liberated by the Americans, then being used as a concentration camp by the Soviet Union where 7,113 people died. Gaze upon the empty fields but intact ovens and realize the horrors humanity is capable of. If you are feeling too happy, this place will change that.

properties.name: Wurstelprater
properties.description: Vienna's Prater has been operating as a permanent fairgrounds since 1895, and the rides reflect that. The Ferris Wheel Wiener Riesenrad has been operating since 1897, and the Hochschaubahn scenic railway has been operating since 1950. There's 14 rollercoasters in total - keep in mind that you have to pay separately for every ride at this park.

properties.name: Schloss Schönbrunn
properties.description: The Schönbrunn Palace is the Austria-Hungarian version of Versailles. The 400 acres of the grounds are home to the the Kaiserliche Wagenburg (Imperial Carriage Museum) consisting of the vehicles of Holy Roman Empire, Austrian Empire, and Austria-Hungary; the Tiergarten Schönbrunn zoo (est. 1752); and gardens.

properties.name: KZ Mauthausen
properties.description: KZ Mauthausen was a Nazi concentration camp where through forced labor and extermination 90,000+ people were killed. Much of the facility is still intact, making for a haunting memorial.

properties.name: Heeresgeschichtliches Museum
properties.description: The Vienna Museum of Military History features the car and clothing and weapons that Archduke Franz Ferdinand was assassinated with in 1914 - sparking WW1. There's also the armor and equipment used by Austria from the periods of the Holy Roman Empire, Austrian Empire, Austria-Hungarian Empire, and finally as Austria. There's some nice paintings, artillery, airplanes, and armored vehicles in here as well.

properties.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
properties.description: At the Vienna Museum of Art History the pilfered artifacts are fancy, the armor is lavish, and the paintings here are even fancier. They got the one where they're building the Tower of Babel.

properties.name: Hofburg
properties.description: The Hofburg palace was the seat of power for the Hapsburg dynasty since 1279, now the sprawling palace is: the residence and workplace of the President of Austria, Austrian National Library (and Papyrus museum), Imperial Treasury - featuring the Austrian crown jewels, Albertina painting museum, Sisi Museum of art and imperial Apartments, Imperial Silver and Tableware Collection, Hofjagd- und Rüstkammer armor museum(part of the KHM group), Ephesos Museum of antiquities (KHM), Weltmuseum Wien ethnological museum (KHM), House of Austrian history museum, Collection of Ancient Musical Instruments (KHM), Austrian Film Museum, and Spanish Riding School where they teach horses to dance.

properties.name: H.R. Giger Museum
properties.street: Rue du Château 2, Château St-Germain, 1663 Gruyères, Switzerland
properties.description: Swiss artist H.R. Giger drew and sculpted sensual biomechanical art that is best known as the basis for the Alien movie franchise. You can see all the art here, including life sized sculptures of the Alien.

properties.name: Verkehrshaus der Schweiz
properties.description: The Swiss Museum of Transport shows off everything transportation related that has ever passed through Switzerland, and receives the most visitors out of any museum in the country. Notable exhibits include: the tourist submersible Auguste Piccard, the 1909 Dufaux 4 - the oldest aircraft in Switzerland,  the only remaining Lockheed Orion, Convair 990 Coronado, tunnel boring machine, the 1848 side-wheel steamer Rigi, an exhibit where you can crash a car at 10km/h, cars arranged in a vending machine like Car Theater, and so so much more!

properties.name: Museum für Musikautomaten
properties.description: The punched tape for musical machines later formed the basis for punch cards in the formation of modern computing. It's a museum full of musical automatons - music boxes, juke boxes, orchestrions, gramophones, musical clocks, and the Organ intended for the RMS Britannic (sister ship of the RMS Titanic).

properties.name: Schweizerisches Militärmuseum Full
properties.description: The Swiss Military Museum features 60+ Swiss, American, Soviet, and German armored vehicles as well as "Bunker Safari" tours of 100+ nearby military bunkers - including the Rein Fortress, Wallbach Command Post, and Reuenthal Fortresses, and a scale model tank driving simulator (reservations required weeks in advance).

properties.name: Železničné múzeum
properties.description: When the Communists were in charge, the locomotives were in just as poor shape as they are in this museum - so it's period accurate. Come see rusty Eastern Bloc locomotives in a train yard with very little supervision.

properties.name: Vojenské historické múzeum Piešťany
properties.description: This former military base has been converted into a museum on the aircraft and tanks of the Czechoslovak Army.

properties.name: Zvolenský zámok
properties.description: Yeah, there's a gothic architecture 14th century historical castle here, but more importantly there's also a replica of the armored train Hurban.

properties.name: Múzeum Slovenského národného povstania
properties.description: In 1944 Slovakians rose up against the Nazis and the Slovak State collaborationists inside Slovakia. The uprising was crushed, and after the Nazis were defeated, the Communists took their place ruling Slovakia until 1989. This piece of brutalist Eastern Bloc architecture houses a museum commemorating the Slovak's struggle for freedom. The armored train Stefanik is here as well.

properties.name: Múzeum letectva Košice
properties.description: While the Museum of Aviation branch of the Slovakian Technical Museum isn't that impressive, they do have the Slovakian version of Air Force One and what few aircraft Czechoslovakia produced for itself before Nazi and Communist takeover.  There's also a train portable nuclear missile, various Soviet aircraft and helicopters

properties.name: Železniční muzeum Lužná u Rakovníka
properties.description: The Railway Museum is owned by Czech railways and covers the history of railways in Czechia from their foundation in the Austria-Hungarian Empire, to independence, to communist domination, to present. As a result the museum is a mixture of Austrian Railways, Czech, and Czech Communist locomotives.

properties.name: Vojenské technické muzeum Lešany
properties.description: This is THE Czech tank museum. The Military Technical Museum Lešany has 350+ tanks and other vehicles representing Czech tank manufacturing, as well as Western and Eastern Bloc tanks. The museum is only open in the summer, but it's free.

properties.name: Vojenské muzeum na demarkační linii
properties.description: This is the second largest tank museum in Czechia, featuring 190+ tanks and other vehicles. There's also a nature trail of Cold War and WW2 fortifications. This museum places a heavier emphasis on WW2 compared to the Military Technical Museum Lešany.

properties.name: Letecké muzeum Kbely
properties.description: The Kbely Aviation Museum is the largest aviation museum in Czechia is located on the first air base established in the country. The collection mostly focuses on Czech aircraft during independence and Communist rule. There are 275+ aircraft here in 4 hangars, including a Tupolev Tu-104, Yak-24, and Soyuz space capsule

properties.name: Muzeum městské hromadné dopravy
properties.description: The Museum of Public Transport in Prague hosts a fine collection of 50+ Communist trams and buses in the Střešovice depot.

properties.name: Dolní oblast Vítkovice
properties.description: The Vítkovice ironworks and mine have been the center of Czech steel production since the 19th century. The former site is now an open air-museum cultural complex, including: the National Agricultural Museum, The Science and Technology Centrum, a theater located in a gas tank, and the the Futureum art museum.

properties.name: Muzeum kočárů
properties.street: nám. Svobody 377, 798 58 Čechy pod Kosířem, Czechia
properties.description: The 70+ carriages at this museum are particularly ornate and capture Central European woodworking talent. The museum is only open in the summer.

properties.name: Bouda (dělostřelecká tvrz)
properties.description: Czechoslovakia built massive underground bunker complexes to protect themselves from German attack - only for these fortresses to be turned over without a fight after the Munich Betrayal in 1938. The Bouda Artillery Fortress is one of the most intact facilities remaining - despite the notable evidence of shelling.

properties.name: Hanička (dělostřelecká tvrz)
properties.street: Rokytnice v Orlických horách 70, 517 61 Rokytnice v Orlických horách, Czechia
properties.description: The Hanička artillery fortress of the 1930s Czecoslovak fortifications was converted into a nuclear fallout shelter.
